title: Actual morphisms of normalized successive Kummer charts
statement: Fix the all-continuous coefficient ring, ordinary internal module derived functors [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and normalized successive Kummer chart data [def-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-chart]. Define the actual geometric arrow into the inner-first total by the geometric resolved augmentation, canonical degree-zero transport and specified invariant augmentation comparison [def-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-coordinates], [lem-sfb-condensed-product-bar-comparison]. A morphism between two such field charts consists of the actual extension arrow restricting to the given puncture morphism, its equivariance equation on the full profinite parameter scheme, the condensed coefficient arrow, its exact point-pullback equation, and both derived geometric naturality squares: the full-nerve comparison and the actual successive augmentation arrow commute with the puncture morphism and the condensed coefficient map after their respective derived invariant functors. Define full faithfulness of lisse-extension puncture restriction after every weakly etale tower base change [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], including unique extension of every puncture isomorphism. Define ordinary scalar extension to the norm-topological algebraic closure using the actual continuous coefficient map [def-sfb-kummer-coefficient-models], and its canonical puncture comparison using inverse-image/scalar-extension coherence alone. These are explicit specifications and maps, with no existence assertion, no direct-image/scalar commutation and no chosen substitute arrow.
